name: Hackathon weekend
description: LauzHack: ~300 people use the whole building day and night for a weekend (cafe, halls, classrooms and computer rooms as hacking space); occupancy follows the hackathon column of schedule.csv.

name: New research lab moves in
description: A new lab brings 60 people: more desks, plug loads, coffee and hot water, and more air needed per floor.

name: Energy price spike

name: Heatwave summer
